prompts.V2-parallel-rounds:
Work in rounds of PARALLEL tool calls and do not write any prose until every round is done.
Round A — in ONE turn, call search_documents four times in parallel: 'project plan', 'milestones', 'owners', 'risks'.
Round B — after those return, in ONE turn, call search_documents four more times in parallel for the details of each milestone you found (use your best query if nothing was found).
Round C — after those return, in ONE turn, call execute_code twice in parallel: one to count milestones per quarter, one to draw a bar chart of them.
Only after Round C has returned may you write your answer. Never skip or merge a round.
